_doc: Kokoro has no emotion tags. This file covers voice comparisons (same sentence, different voices, including the older German voice martin), speed, and pronunciation markup [word](/IPA/), each with and without.

samples.text: Ein neuronales Netz lernt seine Gewichte durch Gradientenabstieg. Dabei wird der Fehler Schicht für Schicht zurückgerechnet.
samples.note: Default voice (Thorsten-Voice, real recordings). Compare with the next four: same sentence.
